name: Yorùbá professional travelling theatre
description: A professional Yorùbá troupe performed evolving oral dramas for audiences in different locations.

impact.note: One troupe within an existing Yoruba travelling-theatre practice; regional audiences, modest change, some carry-over into later Yoruba screen production.

date.basis: Date of the specified episode, not a global origin claim.

events.statement: Oyin Adéjọbí re-established his troupe as secular professional commercial travelling theatre.
events.scope: This documented community and episode; not a global first.
